title: Network snapshot
description: The PC's current network details. Sent by POST /api/agent/network when the connection opens and whenever the network changes (IP, gateway, DNS, connection type, SSID).

ip_addresses.description: IPv4 and IPv6, excluding IPv6 link-local

mac_addresses.description: Upper-case, colon-separated; adapters that carry the default route or an address

ssid.description: null when not on Wi-Fi or hidden by the OS
